# Chan Chak Fung (陳澤鋒)

> Hong Kong entrepreneur, AI researcher, technology observer and Low-Altitude Economy (LAE) consultant. General Manager & Technical Director with 7+ years driving digital transformation across the UK and Hong Kong. Available for keynote speaking, corporate training, AI/business consulting and Low-Altitude Economy advisory.

Chan Chak Fung (also known as CF Chan) works at the intersection of artificial intelligence, technology strategy, business transformation and Hong Kong's emerging Low-Altitude Economy (drone industry). He holds a BEng in Electronic & Electrical Engineering, is an alumnus of Swansea University and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and holds a Small Unmanned Aircraft Advanced Rating.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cfchan.hk/): Overview of services — speaking, training, consulting, AI & technology solutions.
- [About](https://cfchan.hk/about.html): Biography, professional identities (entrepreneur, AI researcher, technology observer, drone industry expert), education and credentials.
- [Blog](https://cfchan.hk/blog.html): Essays on AI, the Low-Altitude Economy, entrepreneurship, business and society, published on [Substack](https://cfchan.substack.com/).
- [Contact](https://cfchan.hk/contact.html): How to book speaking engagements, training, or consulting — email chanfungcf@outlook.com.
